title: The Ugly building on the square
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：ugly　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ugly 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the tailor wrote of ① an ugly building on the square in the order, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② more ugly than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the tailor, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the ugly ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most ugly building on the square anybody in the shop had ever seen, or so the order for November 1987 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too ugly to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the ugly ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an ugly scar on his hand, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as ugly as the scar on his hand they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was ugly or not, and he said so.

By 2000 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was ⑦ something ugly, and nothing besides. The customer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite ugly; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the order kept the names of the ugly ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2003, year after year, she wrote of another ugly building on the square in the same order, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more ugly than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most ugly scar on his hand in the whole shop, she said in 2005, was the one she could never quite name; the ugly ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 丑陋（前置定语 an ugly building on the square：1993 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的那件丑陋的房子）
B. adj. 丑陋／难看（比较级 more ugly than：文中两处，一处比广场上难看的房子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 丑陋／难看（最高级 the most ugly：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 丑陋（表语 too ugly to do：母亲觉得它太丑陋，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 难看（前置定语 an ugly scar on his hand：叔叔把整件事称作一桩难看的疤）
F. adj. 难看（同级比较 as ugly as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩他手上难看的疤相比）
G. adj. 难看（后置定语 something ugly：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 难看（受程度副词修饰 quite ugly：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: an ugly building on the square
the most ugly building on the square anybody
an ugly scar on his hand
The most ugly scar on his hand in

answers.why: ugly 意为“丑陋”，1993 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的是“一件丑陋的房子”，此处作前置定语 an ugly building on the square。
ugly 意为“丑陋”，此处用比较级 more ugly than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
ugly 意为“丑陋”，订单簿上 十一月 那行字说它是裁缝铺里最丑陋的一件，故用最高级 the most ugly building on the square。
ugly 意为“丑陋”，母亲认为这件东西“太丑陋了，谁也用不上”，too ugly to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
ugly 意为“难看”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩难看的疤”，此处作前置定语 an ugly scar on his hand。
ugly 意为“难看”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩他手上难看的疤一样难看”，同级比较用 as ugly as。
ugly 意为“难看”，订单簿上那半行字要的是“难看的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something ugly。
ugly 意为“难看”，邻裁缝铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当难看”，quite 修饰原级 ugly。
ugly 意为“难看”，2003 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要难看”，故用比较级 more ugly than。
ugly 意为“难看”，母亲 2005 年说的是“整个裁缝铺里最难看的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most ugly scar on his hand。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1993 年，裁缝在订单簿里记下了一件丑陋的房子。（an ugly building on the square）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更丑陋。（more ugly than …）
母亲觉得它太丑陋，谁也用不上。（too ugly to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩难看的疤。（an ugly scar on his hand）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩他手上难看的疤一样难看。（as ugly as …）
到了 2000 年，订单簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件难看的东西。（something ugly）
answers: In 1993 the tailor wrote of an ugly building on the square in the order.
Everybody said it was more ugly than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too ugly to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an ugly scar on his hand.
He said nobody would call it as ugly as the scar on his hand they had once had.
By 2000 the order asked for nothing but something ugly.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 ugly 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the tailor wrote of an ugly building on the square in the order, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most ugly building on the square in the shop, or so the order says.
My mother thought it too ugly to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an ugly scar on his hand, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next shop called the plan quite ugly, and everybody laughed.
The ugly ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
